def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import glob
    import os

    paths = [
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2022.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2016.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2018.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2009.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2010.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2005.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2013.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2002.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2014.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2006.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2008.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2019.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2004.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2007.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2003.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2012.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2017.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2021.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2015.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2020.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2011.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2023.csv",
    ]

    matched = []
    for p in paths:
        if any(ch in p for ch in ['*', '?', '[']):
            matched.extend(glob.glob(p))
        else:
            matched.append(p)

    if len(matched) == 0:
        raise FileNotFoundError("No files matched the provided paths")

    dfs = []
    for path in matched:
        year = int(os.path.basename(path).split('-')[-1].split('.')[0])
        df = pd.read_csv(path, dtype=str)
        df['sourceFile'] = os.path.basename(path)
        df['year'] = year
        dfs.append(df)

    return pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True, sort=False)

operators.customDisplayName: Load and vertically concatenate water-body-testing CSVs for years 2002-2023 from the provided paths (supports glob patterns); read all columns as strings; append metadata columns [sourceFile, year] derived from filename; return combined table

def process(loadAllYears) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = loadAllYears.copy()

    # --- Identify/standardize key columns ---
    # year
    if 'year' not in df.columns:
        if 'Year' in df.columns:
            df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
        else:
            raise ValueError('No year column found (expected year or Year).')

    # water type (fresh vs marine)
    water_col = None
    for c in ['Beach Type Description', 'Beach Type', 'Water Type', 'Waterbody Type']:
        if c in df.columns:
            water_col = c
            break
    if water_col is None:
        raise ValueError('Could not find water type column (expected Beach Type Description / Beach Type / Water Type / Waterbody Type).')

    # exceedance indicator: prefer explicit Violation column
    if 'Violation' not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("Could not find 'Violation' column to determine bacterial exceedance.")

    viol = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # map common yes/no variants; anything else => unknown
    exc = np.select(
        [viol.isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', 't', '1', 'violation', 'exceedance', 'exceeded']),
         viol.isin(['no', 'n', 'false', 'f', '0', 'non-violation', 'nonviolation'])],
        [True, False],
        default=np.nan
    )

    df['_exceed_bool'] = pd.Series(exc, index=df.index)

    # freshwater beaches filter: water type contains 'fresh'
    water = df[water_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    fresh_df = df[water.str.contains('fresh', na=False)].copy()

    # denominator: only rows where exceedance is determinable
    fresh_df = fresh_df[fresh_df['_exceed_bool'].notna()].copy()
    fresh_df['_exceed'] = fresh_df['_exceed_bool'].astype(bool).astype(int)

    grp = (
        fresh_df.groupby('year', as_index=False)
        .agg(samples=('year', 'size'), exceedances=('_exceed', 'sum'))
    )
    grp['exceedRate'] = grp['exceedances'] / grp['samples']

    overall_avg = float(grp['exceedRate'].mean())
    grp['overallAvg'] = overall_avg

    # compare rounded-to-2dp values as requested
    grp['exceedRate2dp'] = grp['exceedRate'].round(2)
    grp['overallAvg2dp'] = round(overall_avg, 2)

    higher_years = grp.loc[grp['exceedRate2dp'] > grp['overallAvg2dp'], ['year']].sort_values('year')
    higher_years['year'] = higher_years['year'].astype(int)

    return higher_years.reset_index(drop=True)

operators.customDisplayName: From combined water-body-testing data: filter to freshwater beaches using water type column ('Beach Type Description' if present, else fallback); determine bacterial exceedance from 'Violation' by mapping common yes/no variants case-insensitively and dropping unknowns; compute per-year exceedance rate = exceedances/samples; compute overall average exceedance rate across years; round yearly rates and overall average to 2 decimals and return years where yearly (2dp) > overall average (2dp)
From exceedanceByYear, sort years ascending and return a single-row DataFrame with column 'years' containing the Python-list representation as a string (avoids runtime LIST attribute type error)
